# Jean-Pierre Boutros

> Lebanon-based international sound engineer. FOH, monitors, recording, mixing, mastering, broadcast and audio system integration. Worldwide projects and travel by arrangement.

Professional name: Jean-Pierre Boutros (also written Jean Pierre Boutros).
Contact: jp@jeanpierreboutros.com · WhatsApp +961 3 883 863.

## Main pages
- [Professional profile](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/): Biography, collaborations, portfolio and contact.
- [Services](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/services/): The six documented service areas.
- [Project records](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/projects/): All 28 projects with role, context and sources.
- [Studio credits](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/studio-credits/): Jean-Pierre Boutros’s recording, mixing and mastering roles for released songs and albums.
- [International projects](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/international-projects/): Locations of documented work and worldwide availability.

## Services
- [Live sound & FOH engineering](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/live-sound-engineer/): Jean-Pierre Boutros is a Lebanon-based international live sound engineer whose documented work spans front-of-house mixing, artist monitors, concert stages and festivals.
- [Orchestra & live performance sound](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/orchestra-sound-engineer/): Jean-Pierre Boutros provides FOH sound engineering for orchestras and live performances, with documented work involving the Qatar Philharmonic, Lebanese National Philharmonic and Istanbul Philharmonic orchestras.
- [Recording & tracking](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/recording-engineer/): Jean-Pierre Boutros is a recording and studio sound engineer based in Lebanon. He founded StudioJPB in Jounieh in 2008, with work spanning recording, mixing and mastering.
- [Studio mixing & mastering](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/mixing-mastering/): Jean-Pierre Boutros provides studio mixing and mastering as part of his professional sound engineering practice. His StudioJPB history dates to 2008 in Jounieh, Lebanon.
- [Broadcast audio engineering](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/broadcast-audio-engineer/): Jean-Pierre Boutros is a live, studio and broadcast sound engineer based in Lebanon. His documented broadcast work includes the Papal Mass at Beirut Waterfront during Pope Leo XIV’s 2025 visit.
- [Studio system integration](https://www.jeanpierreboutros.com/studio-system-integration/): Jean-Pierre Boutros’s audio system integration work includes Merwas Studios in Riyadh and Playsound Studios in Lebanon, alongside his own StudioJPB practice in Jounieh.
